title: Autoimmune Cytopenia and BcR Inhibitors
brief_summary: Efficacy of BCR Inhibitors in the Treatment of Autoimmune Cytopenias Associated with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL): A Retrospective Analysis of the French Innovative Leukemia Organization (FILO)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with CLL
* Active autoimmune cytopenia
* Initiation of a treatment with ibrutinib or idelalisib for autoimmune cytopenia.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other lymphoid hemopathy B
* Absence of documentation of the autoimmunity of cytopenia
study_population: Patients with CLL and active autoimmune cytopenia treated with ibrutinib or idelalisib for autoimmune cytopenia.
condition: Autoimmune Cytopenia Associated With Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
